body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> The patent pending PowerPak™ chargers are the only travel chargers with a built-in battery.

The PowerPak™ XT will safely power your USB devices at home, in the car, at the airport, or anywhere else. If your device is running low on juice, the PowerPak™ XT built-in battery reserve will refuel it, whether there is a wall outlet available or not.
When plugged into a wall outlet, the PowerPak™ XT will recharge itself, as well as your handheld device. 1600mAh internal lithium ion battery provides up to 4 1/2 hours of extra talk time.
Internal battery will hold a charge for up to 1 year. Eco friendly power solution draws very minimal power from the wall outlet when no additional power is needed.

LED indicator lights reveal the remaining capacity of the PowerPak battery reserve with the press of a button. USB port allows for universal compatibility. The PowerPak is compatible with your device's current USB cable, as well as the provided USB cable and connectors.
